note: Former/popular names for a ground we already carry under a different (current/official) name. Each entry points straight at the ground's own id -- never a name substring -- so a search never has to guess between two grounds that happen to share a word (see the app note on 'Achter de Kazerne' below). Consumed by the CSV importer's ground matching (src/data/store.ts); NOT the same list as GROUND_NICKNAMES (fan search-as-you-type + OCR ticket scanning), which is matched by name substring and would be ambiguous for some of these.

aliases.source: Belgium's national stadium was called Heizelstadion before the 1985 Heysel disaster; rebuilt on the same site and renamed Koning Boudewijnstadion/Stade Roi Baudouin. Also findable via the bilingual-name-halves matching added alongside this file, since our own row already carries both languages.
